skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Scribing
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Scribing. The dust settles, the noise stops, and Nuova Volsinii finally quiets down. Here, the judge sheds her robes of the law, and with pen in hand, she writes of the turmoil that once rocked Siracusa.
skins.quote: A parting is not always caused by cruelty, just as a record does not always stem from remembrance.

skins.name: Occasionally Flushed
skins.content: Penance's casual outdoor wear/Occasionally Flushed. Sometimes, Lavinia will tolerate a hint of aqua between her otherwise pure black skirt and white coat.
skins.quote: A judge must be ever vigilant and rational, but sometimes Lavinia allows herself to get lost in her cup. In her inebriated dreams, her mailbox is filled with letters and gifts of appreciation.
